verdict.rationale: The evidence shows scans are stored as PDFs in unlimited cloud storage. It also mentions a gated, undocumented API and Zapier integration, but no documented bulk export of scans or mail-history metadata. The API and Zapier are developer building blocks or workarounds a user could use to build an export; they are not the export capability itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an operator, I can export my scans and mail history in bulk — PDFs and metadata leave the platform when I do
